name.ja: この実行例の式と条件

note.ja: 局所幅.8、mixedのみ確率.1でy=−x+.8Z、それ以外y=x+.8Z。混合率は状態非依存でq(y|x)=q(x|y)のため対数標的比でMH判定。各鎖は独立PCG64 stream、提案の適応・棄却の間引きなし。
note.en: Local scale.8; mixed uses y=−x+.8Z with probability.1, otherwise y=x+.8Z. The state-independent mixture is symmetric q(y|x)=q(x|y), so MH uses the log-target ratio. Chains use independent PCG64 streams, with no adaptation or removal of rejected states.

name.ja: この実行例の式と条件

note.ja: 原著式から独自実装。odd長は中央1標本を落としてsplit、平均順位のBlom式は訂正済みS+1/4、fold後再rank、最大Rhatを採用。bulk ESSはrank split、tail ESSは元の全鎖のType7分位点を先に求めた≤indicatorをsplit。Geyer initial-positive/monotoneと宣言した端点処理・tau≥1/log10(total)を用い、反相関ESSをNへclipしません。
note.en: Original equation-based implementation: split with the odd center dropped, average-tie Blom ranks using corrected S+1/4, re-rank folded deviations, and take the larger Rhat. Bulk ESS uses rank-split draws; tail ESS first determines Type7 quantiles on original full draws, then splits <= indicators. Use initial-positive/monotone pairs, declared endpoint handling and tau>=1/log10(total), without clipping antithetic ESS to N.

name.en: Multimodal MCMC: trapping, false reassurance and a global proposal — references and comparison conditions

note.ja: 既知の2峰Gaussian混合の解析的な密度・モーメント・指定点CDF・正側占有と照合し、診断量は独立ArviZ参照で確認します。峰への閉じ込めと多鎖診断の限界を区別し、局所診断の良さを全体混合の保証にしません。
note.en: Compare with the known bimodal Gaussian mixture’s analytic density, moments, declared CDF points and positive occupancy, and check diagnostics against independent ArviZ references. Distinguish trapping from diagnostic limitations; reassuring local diagnostics do not guarantee global mixing.

name.ja: 多峰性MCMC：峰への閉じ込め・偽の安心・大域提案：参照・検証
name.en: Multimodal MCMC: trapping, false reassurance and a global proposal — references and checks

note.ja: 解析平均・分散・CDFの指定7点・正側占有と照合。各鎖の占有率と峰間遷移、rank/folded split Rhat、bulk/tail/mean・modeindicator ESS、鎖内だけのACF/ESSを記録。分散trapped鎖はpooled分布が良くてもRhat/多鎖ESSで失敗、same-mode鎖はRhatが良くても既知標的に失敗する対照です。scenario passはこの期待失敗を検出できた意味です。CDF差は指定点最大でKS全域距離・IID検定p値ではありません。
note.en: Compare with analytic moments, seven declared CDF points and positive occupancy. Record per-chain occupancies/transitions, rank/folded split Rhat, bulk/tail/mean and mode-indicator ESS, and within-only ACF/ESS. Dispersed trapped chains can have a good pooled distribution yet fail between-chain diagnostics; same-mode chains can have reassuring Rhat yet fail the known target. A control scenario passes when its intended failure is detected. CDF error is a declared-point maximum, not whole-line KS distance or an IID-test p-value.

name.ja: MCMC診断の独立照合：rank Rhat・bulk/tail ESS・退化条件：参照・検証
name.en: Independent MCMC diagnostic checks: rank Rhat, bulk/tail ESS and degeneracies — references and checks

note.ja: 実鎖9組×3prefix×x/indicator＋8小fixtureの62組。同じbytesを再生成して照合し、通常の有限値Rhat/ESS/ACFと、定数・鎖内ゼロ分散・odd・ties・shift・scaleを検査。別の直接lag和、定常AR(1)の無限列tau=(1+rho)/(1−rho)で有限推定の誤差も測定します。routineは保存参照との照合で、ArviZのその場再実行は任意の別手順です。
note.en: 62 datasets: nine actual chains times three prefixes times x/indicator plus eight small fixtures. Regenerate and hash identical bytes; compare ordinary finite Rhat/ESS/ACF and test constants, zero within-chain variance, odd lengths, ties, shift and scale. Direct lag sums and infinite-series stationary-AR(1) tau=(1+rho)/(1−rho) provide separate checks of finite estimates. Routine runs compare stored references; live ArviZ regeneration is a separate optional procedure.
